fluff.overview: The Capellan Confederation has always relied on its infantry to compensate for the CCAF's chronic shortage of heavier assets. Conventional foot soldiers, drawn from the citizens' militia system that defines Capellan military service, form the backbone of garrison forces across the Confederation's commonalities. CCAF foot platoons anchor the Confederation's garrison network, holding worlds that BattleMech forces cannot permanently occupy. Slow and vulnerable in open terrain, they depend on prepared positions and local knowledge to offset their lack of mobility. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these platoons deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile. Trained as sappers, these platoons specialize in demolition, obstacle breaching, and field fortification work, giving commanders the ability to shape terrain and deny it to the enemy.
